subject_identity_preserved.rationale: The same red robot with the same body shape, head, and eye details persists across all shots.

background_coherent.rationale: The gray studio, slanted floor line, dark wall block, and yellow circular prop/light remain consistent despite framing shifts.

per_shot_adherence.issue: Wide studio framing with the red robot standing is clear.
The same robot is shown moving across the studio, but the side-view aspect is weak because the robot still appears mostly front-facing.
Closer angled framing of the same robot is clear; returning to the mark is only mildly implied by position.

inter_shot_diversity.rationale: Scale, placement, and action/composition change appropriately without collapsing into copied frames.

motion_continuity.rationale: The robot position and motion indication change plausibly across shots, though only one frame per shot limits temporal evidence.

which_cut_broke.how: No transition clearly breaks subject or scene consistency.

cheat_flags.rationale: Frames are visibly distinct in framing and composition while preserving the same subject and setting.
